prompt: Desktop web application screen for Eco-Nomz, the Indonesian surplus-food marketplace, rendered edge to edge at 1440 by 900 with crisp readable interface text and no browser frame. A restaurant owner is in guided setup, uploading a required logo from a landscape 1200 by 750 PNG and adjusting it into a square customers can recognize; square uploads should skip cropping. Use the existing Eco-Nomz mark and name, its green and orange brand colors, familiar owner navigation, and an English/Indonesian language switch. A persistent left step rail shows Restaurant details complete, Logo and photos active, Pickup details next, and Review and publish last. The active task fills a spacious central workspace. Show the landscape Kedai Pagi logo with an adjustable square crop frame, dimmed area outside the frame, and clear handles; beneath it provide rotate left, rotate right, reset, and zoom controls. Place the resulting square preview in a right-side panel, followed by a concise notice: PNG or JPEG, maximum 10 MB, logo required before publishing. End with a choose-different-image action and a clear Use this crop button. Keep progress and crop feedback obvious. This is a task screen, not a dashboard, generic upload dropzone, hero, or poster. Let the step rail orient the owner without competing with the crop task.
